Otherwise actor/optional approval is authorized; handler reads other days no-tracking and invokes BusinessDayRules.Reopen, which requires Closed status, no other active day, existing snapshot and nonempty reason. It mutates reopen lineage and clears closing checklist completions, saves attempted+success audits with day in one SaveChanges (no explicit transaction). findings_reconfirmed: Checkout receipt/source supports FIN001 and conditional stale-shift admission; replay/payment realization limits preserved.
Refund source supports FIN003 collection-entitlement and FIN004 cross-shift cash-reconciliation mechanisms; order-total clamp and serialized same-order balance protections are counterevidence.
Cancel-pending source changes order/audit only and writes no treasury movement; cancelled-order stock handling remains policy/operational question.
Expense and employee cashout source paths lock/check source funds within transaction; open shift/day admission is observed before/without a durable close lease.
Reopen source enforces existing snapshot/reason/no-other-active in application but has no visible cross-day admission lock; concurrent outcome untested.
